methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The paper proposes a new ISO 50001-based energy management maturity model which links ISO 50001 processes and Capability Maturity Model Integration criteria

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper proposes an energy management maturity model (EMMM50001), a qualitative CMMI-based self-assessment tool linking ISO 50001 processes and the PDCA cycle, not an EnPI/EnB measurement model. Energy performance indicators and the energy baseline appear only as ISO 50001 process rows scored on a 1-5 maturity scale, never characterised as a measurement model (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Maturity assessment without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The paper presents a new energy management maturity model.

stage1.notes: Maturity assessment scored via SPSS averages of CMMI 1-5 levels; model is universal across manufacturing and service sectors, not a continuous-process EnPI/EnB study.
